stories.title: Standard Chartered says Arbitrum could outperform Bitcoin and Ether through 2030
stories.summary: Standard Chartered issued a forecast saying the layer-2 network Arbitrum could outperform both Bitcoin and Ether through 2030. The bank's note ties into its broader research coverage of crypto assets and their long-term price paths.
stories.whyItMatters: A large bank publicly ranking an altcoin above Bitcoin and Ether signals growing institutional interest in layer-2 tokens, but bank price forecasts are opinions, not guarantees.
whatToWatch: Whether other banks publish competing or supporting forecasts on Arbitrum
Arbitrum's price and adoption trends relative to Bitcoin and Ether over the coming months
questions: What specific catalysts does Standard Chartered cite for Arbitrum's outperformance?
How does this forecast compare to the bank's track record on past crypto calls?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows return, with BlackRock driving most of the gains ahead of the Fed meeting
stories.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs are seeing inflows return after a stretch of outflows or stagnation, according to CryptoSlate, with BlackRock's fund accounting for the bulk of the new money. The rebound comes as markets position ahead of an upcoming Federal Reserve meeting.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flow data is one of the clearest signals of institutional demand for Bitcoin, and a market leaning on one issuer suggests the rally may be narrower and more fragile than it looks.
whatToWatch: The Federal Reserve meeting outcome and its effect on risk assets including Bitcoin
Whether inflows broaden beyond BlackRock to other issuers
questions: How concentrated are the inflows in BlackRock's fund versus the rest of the field?
Will flows hold up if the Fed's decision disappoints markets?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows are back, but BlackRock is carrying the market into the Fed meeting

stories.title: US House crypto tax package leaves out deferral for mining and staking rewards
stories.summary: A crypto tax package moving through the US House does not include a provision that would have deferred taxation on mining and staking rewards until sale, according to Cointelegraph. The omission means miners and stakers may still face tax obligations at the point rewards are received.
stories.whyItMatters: Tax treatment of staking and mining rewards has been a long-running dispute in the US crypto industry, and this omission keeps that uncertainty alive for validators and miners.
whatToWatch: Whether lawmakers add mining/staking deferral language in later amendments
Industry and lobbying response to the omission
The bill's progress through further House votes
questions: Why was the deferral provision left out of this version of the package?
Could a future Senate version restore it?

sources.title: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral

stories.title: USDT payments reportedly featured in Polish energy giant's failed $230M oil deal
stories.summary: A Financial Times report cited by Cointelegraph says USDT payments were part of a Polish energy company's failed $230 million oil deal. Details of how the stablecoin was used and why the deal collapsed remain limited in the reporting available.
stories.whyItMatters: Stablecoin use in large cross-border commodity transactions, especially one that failed, raises questions about counterparty risk and oversight in energy trade financing.
whatToWatch: Further reporting on why the deal failed and USDT's specific role
Any regulatory or corporate follow-up from the Polish company
questions: What role did USDT play beyond being a payment method — was it central to the deal's structure?
Who were the counterparties, and is any investigation underway?

stories.title: Altcoins gained 21% but still lost ground to Bitcoin — what would flip that?
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports altcoins rose 21% over a recent period but still underperformed Bitcoin on a relative basis. The piece examines what conditions might be needed for altcoins to finally outpace Bitcoin again.
stories.whyItMatters: Altcoin underperformance despite a solid nominal gain shows Bitcoin dominance remains strong, which shapes how traders and funds allocate across the broader crypto market.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin dominance metrics in coming weeks
Any shift in capital rotation from Bitcoin into altcoins
questions: What specific timeframe does the 21% gain cover?
What catalyst, if any, does the analysis identify as most likely to trigger an altcoin rotation?

stories.title: Bitcoin falls to $75.6K September low as global bond yields hit multidecade highs
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped to a September low of $75,600, per Cointelegraph, coinciding with global government bond yields reaching multidecade highs. The moves suggest broader macro pressure on risk assets, including crypto.
stories.whyItMatters: Bitcoin's slide alongside surging bond yields points to tightening financial conditions weighing on risk assets generally, not an isolated crypto-specific problem.
whatToWatch: Whether bond yields continue climbing and how Bitcoin responds
Any Fed or central bank action that could ease or worsen the pressure
questions: Is the bond yield surge driven by inflation expectations, fiscal concerns, or both?
How correlated has Bitcoin been with bonds versus equities in this move?

stories.title: Bitcoin mobile privacy feature aims to hide incoming payments, as miner margins and self-custody tax gaps draw scrutiny
stories.summary: CryptoSlate covered a new Bitcoin mobile wallet privacy feature designed to obscure incoming payment details. The outlet also published related pieces the same day on Bitcoin miners facing a margin squeeze unless price reaches $82,900, and on a cost-basis reporting gap for self-custody holders ahead of 2026 tax filings.
stories.whyItMatters: Privacy tooling, miner economics, and tax reporting gaps each affect different parts of the Bitcoin ecosystem — users, infrastructure providers, and holders — and together suggest growing friction as the network matures.
whatToWatch: Adoption of the new privacy feature and any exchange or regulatory reaction
Bitcoin's price relative to the $82,900 level miners reportedly need
Guidance from tax authorities on self-custody cost-basis reporting for 2026
questions: How does the privacy feature technically hide incoming funds, and does it affect compliance obligations?
How was the $82,900 miner breakeven figure calculated, and by whom?

stories.title: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes affected address
stories.summary: An attempted exploit of an Ethereum wallet backfired when a MEV bot intercepted and captured $7.7 million intended for the attacker, according to Cointelegraph. Kelp has frozen the address connected to the incident.
stories.whyItMatters: The episode is a reminder that Ethereum's MEV ecosystem can redirect exploited funds unpredictably, and that protocols like Kelp retain some ability to freeze compromised addresses.
whatToWatch: Whether Kelp or other parties recover and return the frozen funds
Any further details on how the original exploit was attempted
questions: Who was the original attacker, and what wallet or protocol did they target?
What legal or on-chain process will determine where the frozen $7.7M ultimately goes?

sources.title: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address

stories.title: Talks on shared Ethereum and Base wallet standards have collapsed, Ethlabs researcher says
stories.summary: Discussions aimed at establishing common wallet standards between Ethereum and Base have failed, according to an Ethlabs researcher cited by Cointelegraph. No further detail on the specific sticking points was provided in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Fragmented wallet standards between Ethereum and its major layer-2 networks like Base could complicate user experience and interoperability across the ecosystem.
whatToWatch: Whether talks resume or a unilateral standard emerges from either side
How wallet providers respond to the lack of a unified standard
questions: What specific proposals were on the table, and why did they fail?
Does this affect existing wallet interoperability today, or only future features?

stories.title: Bitcoin short-term holders hit 30-day profit streak, boosting bull-market odds: CryptoQuant
stories.summary: CryptoQuant data cited by Cointelegraph shows Bitcoin short-term holders have been in profit for 30 consecutive days, a pattern the firm links to improved odds of a sustained bull market.
stories.whyItMatters: Sustained profitability among short-term holders is a metric analysts watch for reduced sell pressure and confidence that a price uptrend can hold.
whatToWatch: Whether the profit streak continues or breaks in coming weeks
Corresponding on-chain metrics like exchange flows and holder behavior
questions: How reliable has this specific metric been as a bull-market predictor historically?
Does this data account for the recent drop to a September low reported elsewhere?

stories.title: US seeks to seize $61M in USDT allegedly linked to sanctioned Iranian oil sales
stories.summary: US authorities are seeking to seize $61 million in USDT allegedly tied to sanctioned Iranian oil sales, according to Cointelegraph. The action points to continued use of stablecoins in sanctions-evasion schemes flagged by US enforcement.
stories.whyItMatters: The case underscores how stablecoins remain a target of sanctions enforcement and could increase pressure on issuers like Tether to strengthen compliance controls.
whatToWatch: Progress of the forfeiture case through US courts
Any response from Tether regarding the flagged funds
questions: Which entities or individuals are named in the action, and what is their alleged role?
Has Tether frozen or cooperated with authorities on the addresses in question?

stories.title: Solana treasury firm DeFi Dev Corp launches $300M CHAD vehicle to buy more SOL
stories.summary: DeFi Dev Corp, a Solana-focused treasury company, has rolled out a $300 million vehicle called CHAD aimed at buying more SOL, according to Decrypt. The move adds to the growing trend of corporate treasury vehicles built around holding Solana's token.
stories.whyItMatters: Corporate treasury strategies concentrated in a single altcoin like SOL add a new source of demand but also concentration risk tied to one company's balance sheet decisions.
whatToWatch: How quickly DeFi Dev Corp deploys the $300M into SOL purchases
SOL price and market reaction to the added treasury demand
questions: How is the $300M vehicle funded — debt, equity, or existing reserves?
What happens to DeFi Dev Corp's SOL holdings if the token's price falls significantly?
